column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Malta residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity (stock_pct_mt column) and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_mt: share of the Maltese residential stock by construction cohort.
#   Malta's dwelling stock has grown rapidly since 1990
#   cohorts carry a large share. Distribution approximated from NSO Malta
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Cyprus-proxy TABULA per-cohort
#   class-average space-heating need x climate multiplier (0.7210) x retrofit
#   blend (0.972) + DHW. Malta's residential heating demand is negligible
#   these values have minimal effect on study results.
# Source: NSO Malta census; Cyprus-proxy TABULA (cy_intensities.csv).
